data.narrative: Completed Module 2 'Dependency Mapping' learning about creating DAGs from requirements, identifying critical paths, distinguishing hard vs soft dependencies, detecting circular dependencies, and breaking cycles by splitting nodes into minimal and full versions.

dimension_scores.observation: Grouped 22 Module 1 requirements into 13 buildable work items, ensuring each requirement was covered by a work item
dimension_scores.evidence: artifacts/dependencies/module-02-dag.md contains 13 work items covering all Module 1 requirements

dimension_scores.observation: Created dependency graph with hard/soft labeled edges, identified critical path (11 items), detected circular dependency between Provider Vetting, Admin Dashboard, and Provider Data
dimension_scores.evidence: Dependency graph shows DAG structure with Mermaid diagram and critical path analysis

dimension_scores.observation: Applied double time test to critical path item (Payment Processing) to identify which downstream items are delayed and which parallel tracks remain unaffected, showing resilient plan structure
dimension_scores.evidence: module2_verification.md contains double time test analysis showing 4 items delayed but parallel tracks unaffected

dimension_scores.observation: Each work item has clear cohesive description (1-3 days of focused work), dependencies are labeled as technical vs procedural to avoid false dependencies
dimension_scores.evidence: All 13 work items follow consistent format with scope and dependencies clearly defined

dimension_scores.observation: Responded to circular dependency by splitting Admin Dashboard into Admin Review Tool (Minimal) and Admin Dashboard (Full), breaking the cycle and unlocking parallelism
dimension_scores.evidence: module2_break.md and updated DAG show cycle broken by node splitting technique

dimension_scores.observation: Identified that circular dependency is a design problem not a planning problem - reordering tasks won't fix it, requires splitting nodes into minimal and full versions
dimension_scores.evidence: module2_break.md explains cycle as design problem requiring node splitting

strengths: Created dependency graph with 13 work items covering all Module 1 requirements
Identified and fixed circular dependency by splitting Admin Dashboard into minimal and full versions
Applied critical path analysis and double time test to validate plan resilience
Distinguished hard vs soft dependencies to avoid false bottlenecks
data.recommendation: Use dependency graph as foundation for Module 3 risk-based ordering - tackle high-risk items (payment integration, real-time availability) on or near critical path to retire risk early before committing to dependent paths

public_evidence.artifact: Dependency graph with circular dependency fix
public_evidence.student_action: Created DAG with 13 work items, labeled hard/soft dependencies, identified critical path, and fixed circular dependency by splitting Admin Dashboard into Admin Review Tool (Minimal) and Admin Dashboard (Full)
public_evidence.technical_detail: Graph shows starting points (Auth, Provider Onboarding), endpoints (Notification System, Admin Dashboard), critical path of 11 items, and cycle broken between Listings->Admin Review Tool->Provider Onboarding
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates ability to transform requirements into buildable dependency graphs, identify critical paths, and resolve design-level circular dependencies through node splitting

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Created dependency graph with directed arrows showing what must come before what, no cycles, and graph structure for parallel work
Identified longest chain of hard dependencies (11 items) that sets minimum project duration regardless of team size

concepts_demonstrated.concept: Node splitting to break circular dependencies
concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Split Admin Dashboard into Admin Review Tool (Minimal) and Admin Dashboard (Full) to break cycle between vetting, dashboard, and provider data

learning_style_signals: prefers visual graph representation over adjacency list
